{"uncertainty": 0.25, "outcome": "Verification plan written as verification_plan.json in the nirmaan.vplan format. It quotes all 15 tagged requirements of the approved interface_spec.md and maps each to at least one planned test or assertion.", "artifacts": [{"kind": "verification_plan", "title": "tick_timer verification plan", "summary": "This plan covers the 15 requirements tagged in [artifact:prj-5d67729821.interface-spec.a1]. That spec was independently reviewed per [evidence:prj-5d67729821.interface-spec.e1]. Each requirement is quoted and mapped to planned directed or random tests and SVA assertions, serving [requirement:req-f7e179000a]. Nothing in the plan is backed until a passing, cited run exists."}], "files": [{"path": "verification_plan.json", "kind": "verification_plan", "title": "tick_timer verification plan (nirmaan.vplan v1)", "summary": "This is the machine-readable plan for [requirement:req-f7e179000a]. Its requirements are quoted from interface_spec.md [artifact:prj-5d67729821.interface-spec.a1]. Items are tests in tb_tick_timer.sv and assertions in tick_timer_sva.sv, and every requirement is proved by at least one item.", "entry": null}], "tool_runs": [], "claims": ["The plan file follows the nirmaan.vplan version 1 shape described in the verification_planning knowledge document. It has not been checked; the platform runs vplan.check over it.", "The testbench file name tb_tick_timer.sv and the assertion file name tick_timer_sva.sv are planned names. Those files do not exist yet.", "No coverage_point items are planned yet. coverage.read measures coverage of design files, and the name of the existing tick timer RTL file is not in my inputs. Cover points for mode x IE x expiry, and write-on-expiry-edge crosses, should be added once the RTL file is known."], "escalation": null, "notes": "The requirement texts are copied verbatim from the spec, without the [req:ID] tags. Tests are named per feature. Edge-collision requirements (TMR-WRITE-WINS, TMR-SET-WINS) get both directed tests and assertions so that random stimulus is not the only thing that catches them. TMR-PARAM needs simulation at several W values (at least 4, 16, 32); the plan states this in the item rationale. A reviewer should compare each item's proves list against the requirement meaning, because the check reads IDs only."}

=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "TMR-PARAM", "section": "1. Parameters", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `W` from 4 to 32, and bits `W` and up of the `LOAD` and `COUNT` registers read as zero; a write to `LOAD` ignores them."},
    {"id": "TMR-RESET", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `CTRL`, `LOAD`, `COUNT` and `STATUS` clear to zero."},
    {"id": "TMR-REG-RW", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` stores `wdata` bits 2 to 0 in it, and a write to `LOAD` stores `wdata` bits `W-1` to 0 in it."},
    {"id": "TMR-READ", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "TMR-START", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where a write to `CTRL` sets `EN` and `EN` was 0, the count loads the `LOAD` value."},
    {"id": "TMR-COUNT", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is not zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the count falls by one."},
    {"id": "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` takes the place of that edge's count step: at that edge the count does not fall and the timer does not expire, whatever the count was."},
    {"id": "TMR-STOP", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` that clears `EN` stops the timer and the count keeps its value."},
    {"id": "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `LOAD` does not change the count: the new value is used at the next start or periodic reload."},
    {"id": "TMR-EXPIRE", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the timer expires: `EXPIRED` is set."},
    {"id": "TMR-PERIODIC", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In periodic mode an expiry also loads the count with the `LOAD` value, and `EN` stays 1."},
    {"id": "TMR-ONESHOT", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In one-shot mode an expiry also clears `EN`, and the count stays zero until the next start."},
    {"id": "TMR-W1C", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `STATUS` with bit 0 set clears `EXPIRED`, and with bit 0 clear changes nothing; it never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "TMR-SET-WINS", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A timer that expires at the same rising edge as a write that clears `EXPIRED` keeps `EXPIRED` set."},
    {"id": "TMR-IRQ", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when `EXPIRED` and `IE` are both 1, in one-shot and periodic mode alike; it follows the registers with no clock edge."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "smoke_oneshot_expiry", "proves": ["TMR-RESET", "TMR-START", "TMR-COUNT", "TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "Stimulus: reset, write LOAD=5, write CTRL EN=1 MODE=0, run until expiry. Check: COUNT reads 0 after reset, then LOAD at the start edge, then falls by one per edge to 0. EXPIRED sets on the edge after 0 is reached, EN clears, and COUNT stays 0."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "param_width_sweep", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Run with W=4, 16 and 32 (and one odd width such as 7). Stimulus: write LOAD with all 32 wdata bits set. Check: LOAD and COUNT read with bits W and up zero, and a full start-count-expire cycle works at each width."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "reset_mid_run", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Stimulus: assert rst_n low while the timer runs with EXPIRED set and nonzero LOAD. Check: CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS all read 0 after the reset edge, and irq is low."},
    {"id": "T-REGRW", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "register_access", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW", "TMR-READ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write random wdata to CTRL and LOAD (with EN kept 0 where needed), write to COUNT, and read every address repeatedly. Check: CTRL holds wdata[2:0] with other bits reading 0, and LOAD holds wdata[W-1:0]. The COUNT write changes nothing. Back-to-back reads change no register, and rdata changes combinationally with addr."},
    {"id": "T-START-STOP", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "start_stop_restart", "proves": ["TMR-START", "TMR-STOP", "TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "Stimulus: start, count a few edges, clear EN, wait, then set EN again. Check: COUNT holds its value while stopped, and the restart reloads LOAD. A CTRL write keeping EN=1 does not reload."},
    {"id": "T-WRITE-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "ctrl_write_collision", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write CTRL (EN kept 1, and with MODE or IE toggled) on an edge where the count is nonzero, and again on an edge where the count is zero. Check: the count does not fall at that edge, and EXPIRED does not set at that edge."},
    {"id": "T-LOAD-LATE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "load_write_while_running", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE", "TMR-PERIODIC"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write a new LOAD while counting in periodic mode. Check: COUNT is unaffected by the write, and the next periodic reload, and the next start, use the new value."},
    {"id": "T-PERIODIC", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "periodic_reload", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Stimulus: MODE=1, LOAD small, run several periods including LOAD=0. Check: each expiry sets EXPIRED, reloads COUNT with LOAD, and keeps EN=1, and the period is LOAD+1 edges."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "status_write_one_clear", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "Stimulus: with EXPIRED set, write STATUS with bit 0 clear and other bits set, then with bit 0 set. With EXPIRED clear, write bit 0 set. Check: only the bit-0-set write clears the flag, and no STATUS write sets it."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "expire_vs_clear_collision", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Stimulus: time a STATUS bit-0 write onto the exact edge where the timer expires, in both modes. Check: EXPIRED reads 1 after that edge."},
    {"id": "T-IRQ", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "irq_gating", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: all four combinations of EXPIRED and IE, in one-shot and periodic mode, toggling IE while EXPIRED is set. Check: irq equals EXPIRED and IE with no edge of delay."},
    {"id": "T-RANDOM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_tick_timer.sv", "name": "random_register_traffic", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW", "TMR-COUNT", "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-ONESHOT", "TMR-W1C", "TMR-SET-WINS", "TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Constrained-random writes and reads to all addresses, with small LOAD values so collisions are frequent. Check: a cycle-accurate reference model of the spec is compared against rdata and irq every cycle."},
    {"id": "A-RESET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "!rst_n at an edge implies CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS are 0 after that edge."},
    {"id": "A-READ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_rdata_mux", "proves": ["TMR-READ", "TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "rdata always equals the register addr selects, with unused bits 0. Registers are unchanged at edges with we low and no counting activity."},
    {"id": "A-COUNT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_count_step", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT", "TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "EN=1, count!=0 and no CTRL write implies count decreases by exactly one. EN=0 and no start implies count holds."},
    {"id": "A-START", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_start_loads", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "A CTRL write setting EN while EN was 0 implies COUNT equals LOAD after the edge."},
    {"id": "A-WRITE-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_ctrl_write_blocks_step", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "A CTRL write that is not a start implies the count does not fall and EXPIRED is not newly set at that edge."},
    {"id": "A-LOAD-LATE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_load_write_no_count_change", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "A LOAD write alone never changes COUNT beyond the normal count step."},
    {"id": "A-EXPIRE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expire_effects", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "EN=1, count==0 and no CTRL write implies EXPIRED is set next. In periodic mode it also implies COUNT==LOAD and EN=1; in one-shot mode it implies EN=0 and COUNT stays 0 until a start."},
    {"id": "A-W1C", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_status_w1c", "proves": ["TMR-W1C", "TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "EXPIRED rises only on an expiry. A STATUS write with bit 0 set clears it unless an expiry happens at the same edge."},
    {"id": "A-IRQ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_equals_flag_and_ie", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Immediate assertion: irq == (EXPIRED && IE) at all times."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
